title: OTCP discovery file
description: Content of <discovery directory>/<pid>.json (PROTOCOL.md section 5). Every member is always present; inapplicable values are null. This root schema is closed: a server writes exactly these members. Clients validate against $defs/knownMembers instead, which allows members added by later versions. The ready file written for --control-api-ready-file= is defined in $defs/readyFile (closed) and $defs/readyFileKnownMembers (open).

knownMembers.description: The members this version defines, without forbidding others. Clients validate discovery files against this definition and ignore members they do not know (PROTOCOL.md section 5.4 rule 4).

protocolMajors.description: Protocol major versions this instance serves, ascending.

processStartTimeMs.description: Start time of the OpenTune process as reported by the operating system, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Used with pid to detect process id reuse.

token.description: Per-launch secret sent in session.hello. Never appears anywhere else.

serverProof.description: Per-launch 128-bit value returned by session.hello so that the client can verify it reached this instance.

launchNonce.description: Value of --control-api-launch-nonce=, or null when the option was not given.

buildTag.description: Distribution label of this binary (for example the tag of a published test build), or null for builds without one.

sourceUrl.description: Where the corresponding source code of this build can be obtained.

startedAtMs.description: When the control API started listening, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

readyFile.title: OTCP ready file
readyFile.description: Written after the discovery file is in place and the listener accepts connections. Contains no secrets. Closed: a server writes exactly these members.

readyFileKnownMembers.description: The members of the ready file this version defines, without forbidding others. Clients validate ready files against this definition.
